pages.text: This odd crop sprouts thick spiraling vines that block mobs from passing through. The aroma of a fruiting spireshuck can weaken and repel some undead mobs.
The vines produce a large kernel-like accessory fruit. The fruit has a metallic taste and will temporarily sap your energy if eaten. It will also ward off insomnia and phantom attacks.
The toxins that cause weakness can be extracted and concentrated by brewing the fruit.
The fruit can be processed into more seeds.
The seeds can be processed into pink dye.
